title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.

title: Ellaranthalla Nanna Ganda
desc: When Surya accuses Vishwa Prasad, a politician, of acquiring his position through political influence, Vishwa swears to destroy him.

title: Sita Ramam
desc: Upon returning to Pakistan, Afreen sets off to fulfil her grandfather's wish of delivering a letter from Ram to Sita. Along the way, she finds Ram and learns about their love story.

title: Kaamannana Makkalu
desc: With the help of his two sons, Kaamanna, a former thief, decides to start a new life on the right side of the law.
